items.title: alexeyw/lot-map
items.why: It gives you a visual way to understand how AI agents break down tasks and call tools in real time.
items.summary: Lot-map is a live visual dashboard that displays the internal steps, subagents, and tool calls made by Claude Code as it runs.

items.title: agentes-chat/agentes-chat
items.why: It shows how teams can build open-source workflows that combine human team members with AI agents in chat channels.
items.summary: Agentes-chat is a self-hosted, open-source alternative to Slack where humans and AI agents interact together using models like Claude and ChatGPT.

items.title: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
items.why: This is a practical open-source project showing how to build privacy-focused local AI utilities.
items.summary: Yogurt is a free and open-source application that automatically generates meeting notes privately using local AI.

items.title: Goblinmine/homelab-diagram
items.why: It is a clear example of a beginner-friendly Python project built alongside Claude to convert data files into visual diagrams.
items.summary: Homelab-diagram is a Python script that reads network descriptions written in simple YAML configuration files and turns them into visual image diagrams.

items.title: Tim Peters has died
items.why: As a Python learner, it is valuable to know about Tim Peters, a fundamental developer who shaped Python core concepts.
items.summary: Tim Peters, a legendary Python core developer famous for creating the Timsort sorting algorithm and writing the Zen of Python, has passed away.

items.title: Anthropic IPO
items.why: Anthropic makes Claude, a core tool in modern AI development, making news of its business milestones highly relevant.
items.summary: News and discussions have emerged regarding Anthropic preparing for an initial public offering to list its company on public stock markets.

items.title: I'm making LLMs work on small and old devices
items.why: Learning how developers optimize LLMs for weaker hardware is great practical background for understanding efficient coding.
items.summary: A developer shares practical techniques and experiments for getting Large Language Models to run efficiently on low-power and legacy devices.

items.title: Scandal-hit Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits, plunging AI chipmaking giant into turmoil
items.why: Nvidia is the primary chipmaker powering modern AI, making this executive change major global tech news.
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned amid personal scandal and spy allegations, throwing the world's leading AI chipmaker into turmoil.

items.title: Is Outlook down? Widespread outage hits Microsoft email and other apps
items.why: A major global outage at Microsoft impacts tech infrastructure and daily tools across the tech industry.
items.summary: Microsoft suffered a widespread cloud server outage that disrupted Outlook email, Teams, and Copilot services globally.

items.title: Zelensky welcomes US bringing Europe into Russia-Ukraine peace talks
items.why: This is one of today's most significant major world news updates regarding global diplomacy and peace talks.
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky expressed support for involving European leaders alongside the US in peace negotiations with Russia.
